messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: shiny app question
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to create my first shiny application. Going through some of the tutorials I found online
I was able to adapt the below code for what I need but is not working. I am trying to make plots
based on the selection from the combobox. For example, I want to make plots of x=PD and y=pd,
x=SI and y=si, x=AV and y=av. if the user selects PD, I want a graphic of 'PD' along the x axis and 'pd',
along the y axis, if the user select SI then I want a graphic of 'SI' along the x axis and 'si' along the y axis
and so on.....
 
I am trying to use ggplot2 for my plots but base graphics would be fine.
 
---
title: "plot test"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---
```{r}
test <- structure(list(year = c(1995L, 1995L, 1995L, 1995L, 1995L, 1995L
), PD = c(1137.3, 39.3, 2716.55, 2030.85, 16.1, 639.4), SI = c(0,
0, 10, 69.9, 0, 10.7), AV = c(20.3, 166.9, 0, 0, 0, 0), pd = c(0,
0, 0, 0, 0, 0), si = c(0, 4.668845401, 43.048428885, 102.7539549,
0, 109.011330575), av = c(0, 30.65864884, 0, 0, 0, 29.94842381
)), .Names = c("year", "PD", "SI", "AV", "pd", "si", "av"), row.names = c(NA,
6L), class = "data.frame")
test
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  output$fishPlot <- renderPlot({
   qplot(PD,pd,data=test,geom='point',main=input$specie)
  })
})
```
```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(shiny)
shinyUI(
  fluidPage(   
    titlePanel("First shiny app"),
    #If PD is selected then I want a plot of 'PD' on x axis and 'pd' on y axis
    #If SI is selected then I want a plot of 'SI' on x axis and 'si' on y axis
    #If AV is selected then I want a plot of 'AV' on x axis and 'av' on y axis
    sidebarLayout(     
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput("specie", "SPECIE:",
                    choices=colnames(test[,c(2:4)])),
        helpText("Fish Data")
      ),
     
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("fishplot") 
      )
     
    )
  )
)
```
Can't make the plot display...any help is appreciated

messages.author: 9689631954d04927
messages.subject: Re: shiny app question
parts:
Try this:

shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
    output$fishplot <- renderPlot({
      xval <- test[[input$specie]]
      yval <- test[[tolower(input$specie)]]
      plot(xval,yval) 
  })
})

Note that you have fishplot spelled two different ways in the code you supplied (fishplot and fishPlot)

dave
